content.user_title: Optimize Site Structure and Internal Links
content.value_statement: Important pages often lose visibility when site architecture and internal links are unclear. This skill turns page inventories into scored hierarchy, URL, navigation, and linking plans.
actual_capabilities: Selects architecture or linking mode from the request context.
Builds page hierarchy, URL taxonomy, navigation, and hub-spoke plans.
Finds orphan pages, link islands, deep pages, and weak authority flow.
Creates source, target, anchor, and priority plans for internal links.
Generates Mermaid site maps for hierarchy and link graph review.
Produces a structure score and handoff summary for next SEO steps.
limitations: It does not score CORE-EEAT or replace the content-quality-auditor gate.
It does not analyze external backlinks or offsite authority signals.
It needs a domain, sitemap, crawl export, or page list for measured results.
Crawler and analytics outputs depend on connected tools or user-provided exports.

use_cases.title: Plan a new marketing site
use_cases.description: Design a clear hierarchy, URL pattern, navigation model, and topic cluster map before content production begins.

use_cases.title: Repair a content library
use_cases.description: Find orphan posts, weak pillar links, generic anchors, and deep pages that reduce organic discovery.

use_cases.title: Prepare a site migration
use_cases.description: Map preserved URLs, planned redirects, internal link updates, and structural risks before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Basic Site Architecture
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a site type and goals.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan the site structure for a new SaaS marketing site. Use architecture mode. Include hierarchy, URL taxonomy, navigation, and a structure score.

prompt_templates.title: Find Orphan Pages
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request using an existing sitemap or page list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use linking mode on this page list. Identify orphan pages, deep pages, weak internal links, and recommended source-target-anchor additions.

prompt_templates.title: Build Topic Clusters
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced content strategy request for a blog or resource center.
prompt_templates.prompt: Map hub-spoke topic clusters for this content inventory. Show pillar pages, spokes, missing links, anchor guidance, and priority actions.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Migration Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced restructure request with risk controls.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this proposed URL restructure. Preserve important URLs, flag missing 301 plans, update internal links, and produce a launch-ready handoff summary.

output_examples.input: Plan a new SaaS site around features, use cases, pricing, blog, and resources.
output: Architecture mode selected with a 2 to 3 click target depth.
Output includes a home-to-section hierarchy, URL map, header and footer navigation, hub-spoke plan, Mermaid sitemap, and score.

output_examples.input: Find internal linking opportunities for an email marketing blog post.
output: Linking mode returns orphan pages, under-linked posts, anchor distribution issues, and prioritized links from related articles.
The plan labels each metric as measured, user-provided, or estimated.

output_examples.input: Restructure a content library without losing existing SEO value.
output: The skill flags URL changes that need 301 redirects and pages that must keep internal links.
It provides phased actions and a handoff to the quality audit gate for veto-level risks.

best_practices: Provide a sitemap, crawl export, or page inventory before asking for measured findings.
State the site type, priority pages, and URLs that must be preserved.
Run architecture mode before linking mode when both structure and links need redesign.
anti_patterns: Do not treat estimated crawl depth or link counts as measured data.
Do not change URLs without a redirect map and internal link update plan.
Do not use exact-match anchors repeatedly across many pages.

faq.question: Does this skill crawl my website automatically?
faq.answer: It can use connected crawler tools, but it also works from a sitemap, export, or pasted page list.

faq.question: Can it replace a technical SEO audit?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on structure and internal links, not XML sitemaps, rendering, indexing, or server issues.

faq.question: What does the structure score measure?
faq.answer: It scores orphans, link islands, crawl depth, URL consistency, average links per page, and redirect planning.

faq.question: Does it handle ecommerce sites?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes category, subcategory, product, and faceted navigation guidance with crawl-depth safeguards.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill hosts.

faq.question: What should I provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide the domain, site type, goals, page list, priority URLs, existing URLs to preserve, and analytics context.
